originalDsl:
@diagram architecture
@coralVersion "0.2.8"
@profileVersion "1.0.0"
@catalogVersion "1.0.0"
@conformanceLevel typical
layout [direction: DOWN]

Dev service as "Developer"
Repo database as "Source Repository"
CI service as "CI Server"
Lint service as "Lint Stage"
UnitTest service as "Unit Test Stage"
Build service as "Build Stage"
ImageRegistry database as "Container Registry"
SecurityScan service as "Security Scan Stage"
IntegrationTest service as "Integration Test Stage"
ArtifactStore database as "Artifact Store"
CD service as "CD Server"
StagingEnv service as "Staging Environment"
ApprovalGate module as "Manual Approval"
ProdEnv service as "Production Environment"
Monitoring service as "Monitoring Service"
NotifyService service as "Notification Service"
edge_1 = Dev -> Repo [secondEnd: arrow] as "push commit"
edge_2 = Repo -> CI [secondEnd: arrow] as "trigger webhook"
edge_3 = CI -> Lint [secondEnd: arrow] as "run"
edge_4 = Lint -> UnitTest [secondEnd: arrow] as "passed"
edge_5 = UnitTest -> Build [secondEnd: arrow] as "passed"
edge_6 = Build -> ImageRegistry [secondEnd: arrow] as "push image"
edge_7 = Build -> SecurityScan [secondEnd: arrow] as "trigger"
edge_8 = SecurityScan -> IntegrationTest [secondEnd: arrow] as "passed"
edge_9 = ImageRegistry -> IntegrationTest [secondEnd: arrow] as "pull image"
edge_10 = IntegrationTest -> ArtifactStore [secondEnd: arrow] as "passed"
edge_11 = ArtifactStore -> CD [secondEnd: arrow] as "trigger deploy"
edge_12 = CD -> StagingEnv [secondEnd: arrow] as "deploy"
edge_13 = StagingEnv -> ApprovalGate [secondEnd: arrow] as "request promotion"
edge_14 = ApprovalGate -> CD [secondEnd: arrow] as "approved"
edge_15 = CD -> ProdEnv [secondEnd: arrow] as "deploy"
edge_16 = ProdEnv -> Monitoring [secondEnd: arrow] as "report health"
edge_17 = Monitoring -> NotifyService [secondEnd: arrow] as "alert on failure"
edge_18 = CI -> NotifyService [secondEnd: arrow] as "report status"
